h1_lead: Ran out of gas away from home?
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
coverage_h2: Lexington, and the towns around it
quote_h2: Tell us what is going on with the vehicle
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads, night and out of hours calls. 48 customers have left us a review, averaging 4.9 out of 5. We work out of Lexington and the towns around it.
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: Flatbed carrier loaded with a Jeep on a gravel lot with autumn woods behind

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Telehandler chained down on the flatbed deck on a clear autumn afternoon

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Flatbed loaded with a telehandler at dusk, deck tilted and marker lights burning

reviews.author: Houston Johnston
reviews.text: Super friendly when we spoke several times, and were upfront and honest about what all they had going on. My insurance company dropped the ball with several companies prior to them contacting 1 stop. The guy I spoke to on the phone several times was friendly and helpful, we coordinated the pick up and drop off at the shop so I could get some rest. They called me prior to Moving my job back a little to see if it would be okay for them to get a lady and child off the side of 85 on Sunday night, which I had no issue with. Seemed to stand up guys working hard to take care of everyone as best they could. They can’t control the traffic. Overall I was pleased with the service and will call again if the Jeep breaks down again. Thanks Loren and crew! I’ll recommend them to others needing towing services.

reviews.author: Doug Craver
reviews.text: I have used 1 Stop Towing many times and they have always provided quick professional service. Loren has been great to work with and you will not meet a nicer person. I highly recommend them.
